label: What we build
title: One architecture.
intro: We design complete architectures and interfaces, not isolated gadgets. Our engineering is organised around the aerial platform and the systems that turn many platforms into one network.

areas.title: Aerial platforms
areas.body: Airframes, VTOL and hybrid configurations, with standard payload interfaces, docking and recovery.

areas.title: Distributed sensing
areas.body: Radar, optical and other sensing carried across many nodes, so the picture survives the loss of any one viewpoint.

areas.title: Resilient navigation
areas.body: Navigation that reduces dependence on any single source, including GNSS, by checking sources against each other.

areas.title: Networked autonomy
areas.body: Communications, node health and recovery, with operators kept in charge of every decision that matters.

programmes.name: Vajra-Net
programmes.body: Our core architecture: aerial nodes, a sensing layer and a communications network working as one.

programmes.name: O.M.N.I.S.
programmes.body: A navigation concept that combines several references and lowers its confidence in any source that disagrees.
